segments.sn36.11:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn36.11:1.2: “idha mayhaṃ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.sn36.11:1.4: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā –
segments.sn36.11:1.8: Kiṃ nu kho etaṃ bhagavatā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ –
segments.sn36.11:2.2: Tisso imā, bhikkhu, vedanā vuttā mayā.
segments.sn36.11:2.3: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā –
segments.sn36.11:2.7: Taṃ kho panetaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhārānaṃyeva aniccataṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ –
segments.sn36.11:2.9: Taṃ kho panetaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhārānaṃyeva khayadhammataṃ … pe …
segments.sn36.11:2.15: Atha kho pana, bhikkhu, mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ nirodho akkhāto.
segments.sn36.11:2.16: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā niruddhā hoti.
segments.sn36.11:2.17: Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā niruddhā honti.
segments.sn36.11:2.18: Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti niruddhā hoti.
segments.sn36.11:2.19: Catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā niruddhā honti.
segments.sn36.11:2.24: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti.
segments.sn36.11:2.25: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo niruddho hoti, doso niruddho hoti, moho niruddho hoti.
segments.sn36.11:2.26: Atha kho, bhikkhu, mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ vūpasamo akkhāto.
segments.sn36.11:2.27: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā vūpasantā hoti.
segments.sn36.11:2.28: Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā vūpasantā honti … pe …
segments.sn36.11:2.29: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca vūpasantā honti.
segments.sn36.11:2.30: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo vūpasanto hoti, doso vūpasanto hoti, moho vūpasanto hoti.
segments.sn36.11:2.32: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā paṭippassaddhā hoti.
segments.sn36.11:2.33: Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā paṭippassaddhā honti.
segments.sn36.11:2.34: Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti paṭippassaddhā hoti.
segments.sn36.11:2.35: Catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā paṭippassaddhā honti.
segments.sn36.11:2.36: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca paṭippassaddhā honti.
segments.sn36.11:2.37: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo paṭippassaddho hoti, doso paṭippassaddho hoti, moho paṭippassaddho hotī”ti.

lines: Rahogatavaggassa paṭhame yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ, taṃ dukkhasminti yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ dukkhanti attho.
Saṅkhārānaṃyeva aniccatantiādīsu yā esā saṅkhārānaṃ aniccatā khayadhammatā vayadhammatā vipariṇāmadhammatā, etaṃ sandhāya yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ, taṃ dukkhanti mayā bhāsitanti dīpeti.
Yā hi saṅkhārānaṃ aniccatā, vedanānampi sā aniccatā eva.
Aniccatā ca nāmesā maraṇaṃ, maraṇato uttari dukkhaṃ nāma natthīti iminā adhippāyena sabbā vedanā dukkhāti vuttā.
Atha kho pana bhikkhu mayāti idaṃ na kevalaṃ ahaṃ vedanānaṃyeva nirodhaṃ paññāpemi, imesampi dhammānaṃ nirodhaṃ paññāpemīti dassanatthaṃ āraddhaṃ.
Vūpasamo ca passaddhiyo ca evarūpāya desanāya bujjhanakānaṃ ajjhāsayena vuttā.
Saññāvedayitanirodhaggahaṇena cettha cattāro āruppā gahitāva hontīti veditabbā.
Yaṃkiñci vedayitanti “sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ adukkhamasukhan”ti vuttaṃ vedayitaṃ dukkhasmiṃ antogadhaṃ, dukkhanti vattabbataṃ labhati pariyāyenāti attho.

Yā esātiādīsu yo saṅkhārānaṃ aniccatāsaṅkhāto hutvā abhāvākāro, yā khayasabhāvatā vinassanasabhāvatā jarāya maraṇena cāti dvidhā vipariṇāmanasabhāvatā, etaṃ sandhāya uddissa sabbaṃ vedayitaṃ dukkhanti mayā vuttanti ayaṃ saṅkhepattho.
Tāsaṃ aniccatā ca nāma maraṇaṃ bhaṅgoti katvā tato uttari dukkhaṃ nāma natthīti sabbā vedanā “dukkhā”ti vuttā, yathā “yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhan”ti ca,“pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā”ti ca vuttaṃ.
